stories.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
stories.brief: Maurene Comey believes she was let go from her job as a federal prosecutor because her father is the former FBI director.

stories.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
stories.brief: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

stories.title: Part of Antarctica named after former BBC science correspondent
stories.brief: A stretch of water in the west of the continent is now called the Amos Channel after the ex-BBC journalist.

stories.title: Former army chief Abdul Waheed Kakar passes away in Rawalpindi
stories.brief: Former army chief retired General Abdul Waheed Kakar passed away in Rawalpindi on Monday, a statement by the military’s media affairs wing said. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, expressing condolences at the death of the former general, paid tribute to his “invaluable services” to the Pakistan Armed Forces, state broadcaster PTV reported.

stories.title: Remembering former army chief Gen Abdul Waheed Kakar
stories.brief: Former army chief retired Gen Abdul Waheed Kakar, who played a decisive role in resolving Pakistan’s 1993 political crisis, passed away in Rawalpindi on Monday at the age of 89.

stories.title: Khawaja Asif hints at 'progress' in Makkah alliance’s talks with Iran on Saudi-Houthi conflict
stories.brief: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif on Monday hinted at the possibility of "progress" in a meeting of the Makkah Defence Alliance members with Iran, stating that the participants had likely arrived at a "conclusion" to end Saudi Arabia's conflict with the Houthis.

stories.title: Where have Karachi’s Olive Ridley turtles gone?
stories.brief: Once familiar visitors to Pakistan’s sandy shores, Olive Ridley sea turtles have all but vanished from the country’s recorded nesting grounds. Now, the discovery of a dead turtle on Clifton Beach has brought an old ecological mystery into focus: if these turtles still inhabit the Arabian Sea, where have the breeding females gone?

stories.title: Lahore ranks second globally as air pollution persists across Punjab
stories.brief: Lahore ranked second among the world's most polluted major cities on IQAir's live air quality tracker on Monday, recording an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 199, as pollution remained a concern across Punjab ahead of the peak winter smog season.

stories.title: JI threatens march to Islamabad in mid-November if petroleum levy not abolished
stories.brief: Jamaat-i-Islami (JI) Emir Hafiz Naeemur Rehman on Monday warned that the party would march to Islamabad in mid-November if Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif did not abolish the petroleum levy.

stories.title: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks escalate
stories.brief: Parliament said the two-thirds-majority authorisation allows Sisi to take measures, in coordination with Saudi Arabia, to defend the kingdom’s territory, sovereignty and holy sites. Egypt was involved in a costly military intervention in Yemen in the ​1960s and has not undertaken a large-scale foreign ground deployment since the 1991 Gulf War.

stories.title: Pakistan rejects ‘baseless’ civilian casualty claims by Afghan Taliban
stories.brief: Islamabad accuses the Afghan Taliban of harbouring ⁠militants ​who launch attacks in Pakistan, ​although Kabul denies this, calling the militancy its neighbour's domestic problem.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns 'reprehensible' Houthi attacks in Makkah, Madinah regions
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday strongly condemned "reprehensible" Houthi ballistic missile attacks on October 24 which targeted the Makkah and Madinah regions of Saudi Arabia, including areas in the vicinity of the holy sites, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said.

stories.title: JI to march on Islamabad in mid-November if govt fails to end petroleum levy: Hafiz Naeem
stories.brief: Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) Pakistan Ameer Hafiz Naeem ur Rehman on Monday warned that his party would march towards Islamabad in mid-November if the government failed to abolish the petroleum levy and provide relief to the public.

stories.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
stories.brief: The left-wing incumbent president had lost the first round to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: US court rules daughter of Trump critic James Comey was illegally fired
stories.brief: Maurene Comey had argued that she was fired because her father, former FBI chief James Comey, was target of Trump's ire.

stories.title: NFL today: How to watch Cowboys v Eagles, TV channels & live stream Monday 26 October
stories.brief: The Eagles had already blown a 10-point fourth-quarter lead to the Rams and let the Jaguars come back on them in shocking fashion in London before the Hurts news.The Cowboys have their own enormous issues.

stories.title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know
stories.brief: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus is 355 pages and full of never before disclosed company information.

stories.title: Jordan arrests three suspects over deadly church attack
stories.brief: Jordanian authorities have arrested three relatives over a church attack in Karak that killed eight people.

stories.title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
stories.brief: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.(Image credit: Win McNamee)
